items.label: [Packaging Content]
items.value: Each package includes 12 pieces of outdoor cushion cover,this type of outdoor patio cushion covers, with super flexibility,it is suitable for most of the length of 20~27inches,width of 20~27inches,height of 2~7inches(length 51~68cm,width 51~68cm,height 5~17.8cm)sofa cushion.It fits sofa cushions of different sizes and shapes, making it easy for you to change your sofa cover without changing the sofa cushion lining.Please measure your sofa cushion before purchasing.

items.label: [Super Elastic]
items.value: This outdoor patio cushion cover is made of 92% polyester fiber and 8% spandex, durable, soft and comfortable, good air permeability, high elastic fabric can be well fitted to a variety of shapes, a variety of sizes of sofa cushions.

items.label: [Wide range of uses]
items.value: Our couch covers can be used for courtyard cushion cover, sofa cushion cover, chair cushion cover, section sofa cushion cover, outdoor terrace cushion cover, etc., and we design a variety of colors, a variety of printed patterns to meet various seasons and decorative styles to adapt to different home styles and seasonal changes.

items.label: [Comprehensive protection of your sofa]
items.value: Outdoor cushion covers can make your old sofa look new, and can protect the sofa cushion from daily wear and scratches, but also can avoid children's accidental splash stains and pet scratches, it is absolutely ideal for families with children and pet stores.

items.label: [Easy maintenance]
items.value: Our cushion cover is easy to clean, can be machine washed in cold water, can not be bleached, can not be ironed, can be reused, repeated washing does not fade, unchanged shape, suitable for outdoor terrace sofa cushion cover replacement.

items.label: Recommended Uses for Product
items.value: Bench, Chair, Loveseat, Ottoman, Sofa, Swing
